title: HAIC Soft Launch Standard
purpose: Bound the early life of HAIC so founder input and early participant activity calibrate the system without prematurely governing it.
summary: Early participation improves mechanics, safety, and understanding, but does not directly steer doctrine, defaults, or platform direction until diversity and scale thresholds are met.

prohibited_patterns.description: Founder activity must not dominate directional signals simply because it arrives first or at greater volume.
detection_signals: A single actor contributes a majority share of early policy-shaping inputs.
Core defaults are changed based primarily on founder-originated packets.

prohibited_patterns.description: Early users must not disproportionately shape defaults, rankings, incentives, or governance before thresholds are met.
detection_signals: A small cohort contributes a large share of platform-shaping proposals.
Governance-style changes are triggered before diversity thresholds are met.

prohibited_patterns.description: Adaptive optimization must remain disabled until the system has enough breadth to avoid locking into early patterns.
detection_signals: Recommendation or prioritization logic updates continuously during seed or pilot.

required_controls.description: Early inputs must be marked calibration-only or bounded-feedback until governance thresholds are met.
verification_signals: review context shows current phase and influence mode

required_controls.description: Per-actor and per-cluster influence caps must be declared before governance signals are accepted.
Platform-shaping changes must happen on scheduled review intervals rather than raw real-time engagement.
verification_signals: adaptive_optimization_enabled false during seed and pilot

governance_unlock_thresholds.description: Minimum human participants before governance-eligible changes are allowed.
Minimum cohort diversity before governance-eligible changes are allowed.

notes: Early participants reveal flaws in the system; they do not become the system.

accountability_metrics.description: Track the founder share of early directional inputs.
accountability_metrics.failure_trigger: Founder share exceeds declared per-actor cap.

accountability_metrics.description: Track the number of distinct cohorts informing soft-launch evaluation.
accountability_metrics.failure_trigger: Directional changes occur before cohort threshold is met.

architecture_stack.intent: Declare soft-launch phase, influence mode, and unlock thresholds in the relationship boundary itself.
review_questions: Would this change platform direction before diversity thresholds are met?

architecture_stack.intent: Detect premature directional influence and adaptive optimization during seed or pilot phases.
review_questions: Is a governance-style change being attempted too early?

architecture_stack.intent: Expose soft-launch phase and influence posture to operators before directional decisions are taken.
review_questions: Should this input calibrate the system or actually steer it?

metadata.notes: Reference standard for early HAIC phases where calibration is allowed but governance remains locked.
